item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L017 executed successfully but failed both eligibility criteria. Its pooled weighted training OOF MAE was 8.2230 K, 0.4704 K worse than A05's 7.7526 K and well above the required threshold of 7.7426 K. Its positive-Tc MAE was 9.2567 K, exceeding the fixed G01 guard of 8.8322 K by 0.4246 K, so it cannot be an eligible win. Relative to L014, changing only the cluster0 expert from extra_trees/raw to hist_gradient_boosting/raw worsened pooled MAE from 7.9131 K to 8.2230 K, reported-zero MAE from 5.7750 K to 5.9261 K, positive-Tc MAE from 8.8754 K to 9.2567 K, and high-Tc MAE from 32.7780 K to 35.8528 K. Cluster0 retained severe opposing errors, including 127 K materials predicted near 50.7 K and reported-zero materials predicted near 58–60 K. Thus the estimator change did not reproduce L016's positive-Tc benefit and instead degraded every reported aggregate subgroup.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"The continuation minimum remains pending, with 17 of 22 successful unique cycles completed. Test the untried cluster2 estimator-only analogue: composition input, kmeans3 routing, global extra_trees/raw, and only a cluster2 hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert, leaving cluster0 and cluster1 on global fallback. L013 showed that cluster2 extra_trees/raw slightly improved reported-zero error but worsened positive-Tc and pooled MAE, while cluster2 contains no high-Tc rows; changing only its estimator tests whether smoothing can reverse that localized zero-versus-positive tradeoff without affecting high-Tc predictions. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE is at most 8.832165507919859 K.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All results are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L017 failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard and therefore is ineligible regardless of any route-level behavior.","KMeans cluster identities may shift between folds, and the partitions are operational composition rules rather than verified physical families.","The observed counterexamples are historically measured materials and do not identify new superconductors."]}
